executive_summary: Frozen post-hoc failure diagnosis of three immutable source experiments. No new candidate and no refitting.
scoring: Pinned qfbench2_common.crps_ensemble(fair=True), divided by each frozen past normalization scale; ratio of sums, exactly original source study
balancing: Each origin/release/year has total weight one. Weighted Spearman is Pearson of weighted mid-CDF ranks, including tie midpoints. Group weights are recomputed within each predeclared descriptive stratum. Bootstrap multiplicities are retained, never normalized away.
direction_fold_positive: Release-balanced sign accuracy > 0.50 AND release-balanced Spearman > 0

direction_labels.STRONG: Release-balanced sign accuracy >= 0.60 AND Spearman >= 0.20 AND >=80% evaluable original folds positive (4/5 or 7/8)
direction_labels.MODERATE: Release-balanced sign accuracy >= 0.55 AND Spearman >= 0.10 AND >=60% evaluable original folds positive (3/5 or 5/8)
direction_labels.WEAK: Either release-balanced sign accuracy > 0.50 or Spearman > 0, but MODERATE fails
direction_labels.NONE: Neither metric exceeds its direction/rank null

descriptive_calibration: Closed-form weighted OLS true_delta = intercept + slope * frozen prediction, plus scipy Theil-Sen. Never apply calibration to forecasts.
SD_quintiles: Within original asset/horizon, rank baseline SD in the full evaluated set, no outcome-defined bins
material_sign_correct_improvement: Original full frozen candidate sign-correct CRPS ratio <=0.98; no favorable diagnostic substituted for this axis gate
diagnostic_nonconcentration: Whole-ledger fixed-grid ratio <1, all leave-one-release and leave-one-year ratios <1, no release/year >50% of gross positive block gain

next_axis_rules.A: At least one source: release sign>=0.55, Spearman>=0.10, >=60% original folds positive, original sign-correct loss ratio<=0.98, at least one predeclared fixed-sign whole-ledger curve improves and passes diagnostic nonconcentration
next_axis_rules.B: At least two sources: 0-20 vs 61-90 (both >=5 releases) release sign advantage>=0.05 and rank advantage>=0.10, or pooled 5/21 vs 126/189 ratio advantage>=0.05 with short ratio<1 and long ratio>=1.05. No new thresholds/candidates are fitted.
next_axis_rules.C: At least two sources: lowest-SD quintile>=50% gross positive damage, true/predicted standardized magnitude >=2x highest quintile, raw release rank improves standardized rank>=0.10; raw sign is mechanically invariant
next_axis_rules.D: Requires preserved pre-outcome regime labels and relationships stable in multiple such regimes and reversed between; original annual folds alone do not establish this
next_axis_rules.E: A-D unsupported, robust release-balanced directional information absent or insufficiently stable, no nonconcentrated small-shift improvement satisfying A. Nominal exposed minima alone do not constitute useful information. Search different information families rather than tune failed sources.
next_axis_rules.F: A-D unsupported AND all sources have no positive release direction/rank, no shrinkage or fixed-sign ratio<1, AND no credible different information family remains. Do not infer absence of all possible sources from three failures.

attribution: Report distinct source evidence; F2 requires positive release rank, 0<slope<0.5, sign-correct harmed fraction>=0.25 and nonzero diagnostic shrinkage gain. F1 requires stable release direction and fixed-sign diagnostic improvement without F2. F7 requires cell direction but release accuracy<=0.50 and rank<=0. F3/F4/F6 follow B/C source criteria. F5 requires >=2 negative and >=2 positive annual calibration slopes. F0 requires no positive release rank/direction and no nonzero diagnostic gain. Otherwise F8 mixed/inconclusive. All categories diagnostic, not causal.
source_comparison: Different assets, fold counts and ledgers; not a controlled causal ranking of sources
scope: Already exposed research; no independent OOS evidence; all prior NO verdicts remain NO; no submission and next axis not executed
